summary: Senior Analytics Engineer with 6+ years of experience bridging finance and data engineering across APAC and Europe. Specialises in dbt, BigQuery, and Snowflake to build scalable data models and analytics infrastructure that drive measurable business impact. Chartered Accountant background provides deep expertise in finance data domains, controls, and reporting.

experience.title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Shipping Finance
bullets: Own end-to-end finance-ready shipping cost and revenue models in dbt, BigQuery, and Looker — used as the single source of truth by Finance Ops and Group Reporting throughout month-end close.

Designed and implemented layered data quality controls — dbt tests, reconciliations, anomaly detection — reducing misstatement risk by 90% on €40m of exposure and giving Finance a reliable data foundation.
Embedded a risk-based control framework into core datasets, detecting carrier billing discrepancies and recovering €1.6m in overcharges.

Built and extended monitoring and observability including a full redesign of invoice completeness alerting, delivering faster and more actionable signals for Finance and cutting time-to-detect data issues.

Optimised BigQuery workloads and storage patterns, cutting pipeline runtimes by 75% and reducing query volume by 1.5TB/day through incremental model redesign, cutting compute costs by 15% while maintaining SLAs.

Designed and facilitated the first cross-functional workshop between VGo DSA, VGo Finance Operations, and Group Finance, producing shared alignment on priorities and earning praise from all participants.
Raised dbt unit test coverage from <1% to 50%+ in the vgo_finance domain in four weeks using agentic AI for test data generation; authored a reusable testing guide independently adopted by teammates.
Partner with Finance to translate plain-language requirements and definitions into documented metrics and data models, enabling self-serve analysis and smoother change management when logic evolves.

Presented analytics testing strategy at Forward Data Conference (Paris, Nov 2025) and Data Maker's Fest (Porto, May 2026); moderated and hosted dbt Community Meetup at Vinted Berlin (Sep 2025) and presented at MDS Fest 3.0 (May 2025).

experience.title: Data Analyst, Finance Lead
bullets: Owned the Finance Data Products roadmap as the sole finance data analyst — aligning priorities with company OKRs and acting as product manager, data analyst, and analytics engineer in one role.

Built a centralised data transformation layer in dbt and Snowflake — ingesting data via Fivetran from Salesforce, Stripe, Twilio, and backend systems — to power finance and operational analytics across the business.
Led finance reporting transformation using Looker dashboards, saving 5 FTE days per month in month-end close.
Partnered with data engineering and business teams to harden data pipelines, improving SLA attainment from 88% to 97%.
Mentored and onboarded three new team members to the data stack, accelerating their time-to-productivity.

experience.title: Senior Finance Transformation Consultant
bullets: Led 11 finance digital transformation projects for listed companies across APAC (SGX, HKEX, KLSE, ASX), from requirements to go-live.
Designed consolidation and budgeting solutions in LucaNet and Power BI, cutting reporting and planning cycle times by up to 50%.
Delivered client enablement sessions and documentation, achieving average satisfaction scores of 4.5 / 5.
Appointed as Culture Ambassador for Singapore, driving internal initiatives that improved employee NPS by 20 points.

experience.title: Finance Analyst
bullets: Developed Power BI and Tableau dashboards to track KPIs for 140 staff across 5 process areas, improving service delivery transparency.
Streamlined service delivery reporting across 300 entities in 6 business units by coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, improving data consistency and timeliness across Finance and Operations.
Automated 2 manual finance workflows using UiPath RPA integrated with SAP, saving 50 person-hours per month and freeing the wider team to focus on higher-value work and problem-solving.
